Our values.

Our five core values drive everything we do and help to ensure an innovative, engaging, and safe workplace for our employees.

Our five core values drive everything we do and help to ensure an innovative, engaging, and safe workplace for our employees.

Be Human

Our moral compass is our guiding light. Empathy & compassion drives us. We stand for what is right with a mission to do good, be generous & act in service for our clients, each other, and the world.

Be Curious

We are in a constant state of child-like wonder and vulnerability. We learn and explore new things to push our limits to turn the impossible to possible.

Be Bold

We move with great speed, force and enthusiasm to achieve greatness in our work and purpose. It is better to move fast and make mistakes than move slow and miss opportunities.

Make Magic

We are pioneers of our craft and push for boundless creativity. We go beyond what works to discover what appeals & delights.

Many Faces, One Team

You will find Touchcasters from all over the globe. We work hand-in-hand through cultural, time, and sovereign barriers and yet we esteem and trust each other every day to achieve asynchronous harmony.

Perks & benefits.

We believe in order to perform your best, you have to feel your best. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits and perks package to make prioritizing health, wellbeing and career growth easy.

Remote-first company

Work from the top of a mountain, all the way down to the sandy beaches, anywhere that you call home.

Flexible PTO

Life Happens and as our core values state, Be HUMAN.  We are human and need time away from work now and then.

Company-Wide Shutdown

We like to experiment. We are a company full of innovators, so why not try out something new like a one-week long company-wide shutdown twice a year?  Time to break out those vacation hats or prepare for a nice staycation!

Competitive Benefits
Package

As a Touchcaster, you help keep us running, so we like to return the favor and keep you and your family up and running as well.  Dive into a smorgasbord of benefits that best fit your life!

Visibility to the Top

Be BOLD is a core value at Touchcast and nothing can help you achieve that more than visibility to our Leadership team. Stand out, work hard, and make a difference!

Ample Opportunity
for Career Growth and Development

Be CURIOUS is another core value at Touchcast and one as innovators, we THRIVE on.  As a Touchcaster, we offer ample opportunities to move into new arenas or grow in your current gig.

Work with Fun and
Talented Touchcasters

Of course we believe we are the life of the virtual party and best all around talent there is - come along for the ride of your life!

Home Office Credit
Stipend

Who doesn’t love to shop?  Our home office credit stipend can help you get your home office looking jazzed up or relaxing and serene - whatever you fancy!

Asynchronous, yet
Collaborative Work
Environment

From early bird gets the worm, to the night owls - whatever your preference, you can thrive at Touchcast!  While we provide real-time support to our clients, we encourage you to also work when you are at your best!

Diversity makes us better.

We’re committed to building a team that celebrates multiple points of view and where differences are valued.

We believe that diverse voices and experiences enrich the quality of our interactions, products and company. That’s why we’ve implemented programs to celebrate differences, foster inclusion and never stop learning. Our goal is to create an environment where all our employees feel appreciated and diverse voices are heard clearly.
